name: d'Amico International Shipping S.A.
summary: d'Amico International Shipping S.A., through its subsidiaries, operates as a marine transportation company worldwide. It transports refined petroleum products and vegetable oils through double-hulled vessels. The company serves oil companies and trading houses. It operates a fleet of 27 owned vessels and 2 bareboat chartered-in vessels. The company was founded in 1936 and is based in Luxembourg, Luxembourg. d'Amico International Shipping S.A. is a subsidiary of d'Amico International S.A.
